title: WO View grants Work Orders nav and read-only WO access
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: User can see the WO list and open WO detail read-only; no create/edit/delete affordances appear.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView]: Work Orders nav visible, /workorders list renders, no New/Edit/Delete affordance -> read-only.
notes: WO View grants read-only WO access; no create control.

title: WO View OFF hides Work Orders nav and blocks direct URL
config: perms=[reportsPageAccess] (carrier reportsPageAccess used to satisfy non-empty-role constraint)
expected: With WO View OFF the Work Orders nav is hidden and direct-URL access to a WO is blocked.
actual: nav[Work Orders]=false, /workorders->/reports/punch-clock-activities accessible=false, createBtn=false -> nav hidden and direct URL blocked
notes: WO nav hidden; direct URL blocked (nav-hidden re-corroborated 2026-07-02 via reports-only role)

title: WO Edit grants create/edit of WO fields (asset, advisor, tech, status)
config: perms=[workOrdersView, workOrdersCreateAndEdit]
expected: User can create WOs and edit customer details, asset, service advisor, lead technician and status; cannot delete WOs.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView,workOrdersCreateAndEdit]: /workorders shows New button -> create enabled.
notes: WO Edit grants create/edit; New present.

title: WO Edit OFF blocks create/edit while View remains read-only
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: With Edit OFF the user cannot create WOs or edit WO fields; WO detail stays read-only.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView] only: /workorders list read-only, no New; WO detail no edit controls.
notes: WO Edit OFF -> read-only, no create/edit.

title: WO Delete grants delete WO and invoice reversal (no payments)
config: perms=[workOrdersView, workOrdersCreateAndEdit, workOrdersDelete]
expected: User can delete WOs and reverse invoices when no payments have been made.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView,CreateAndEdit,Delete]: WO detail shows the WO-level more_vert action menu (delete affordance present). Delete NOT executed.
notes: WO Delete grants delete affordance (WO-detail action menu present); not executed per safety.

title: WO Delete OFF hides delete and blocks invoice reversal
config: perms=[workOrdersView, workOrdersCreateAndEdit]
expected: With WO Delete OFF the user cannot delete WOs nor reverse invoices.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView,CreateAndEdit] (no Delete): WO detail has NO WO-level more_vert/delete menu (present in the Delete-enabled run, absent here).
notes: WO Delete OFF -> delete affordance absent.

title: WO cascade: enabling Edit auto-enables View
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: Enabling Edit auto-enables View in the role editor.
actual: Admin role editor: enabling Work Orders 'Create & Edit' auto-checked 'View' (View=true,Edit=true).
notes: Cascade Edit->View confirmed in role editor.

title: WO cascade: enabling Delete auto-enables Edit and View
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: Enabling Delete auto-enables Edit and View.
actual: Admin role editor: enabling Work Orders 'Delete' auto-checked View+Create&Edit (all three true).
notes: Cascade Delete->Edit+View confirmed.

title: WO reverse-cascade: disabling View auto-disables Edit and Delete
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: Disabling View auto-disables Edit and Delete.
actual: Admin role editor: with all three ON, unchecking 'View' auto-disabled Create&Edit and Delete (all three false).
notes: Reverse-cascade View OFF -> Edit+Delete OFF confirmed.

title: WO reverse-cascade: disabling Edit auto-disables Delete
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: Disabling Edit auto-disables Delete while View stays ON.
actual: Admin role editor: with all three ON, unchecking 'Create & Edit' auto-disabled Delete while View stayed ON (View=true,Edit=false,Delete=false).
notes: Reverse-cascade Edit OFF -> Delete OFF, View retained.

title: WOL Edit grants line/part/inspection editing on WOs
config: perms=[workOrdersView, workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit]
expected: User can add/edit lines, move parts, authorize lines, manage part requests, add inspections and edit mileage/engine hours/plate/VIN; cannot delete lines.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView,workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit]: WO detail Lines tab shows 'New Line' and 'Build Lines' -> line editing enabled.
notes: WOL Edit grants add/edit lines.

title: WOL Edit OFF blocks line editing (view-only WO lines)
config: perms=[workOrdersView]
expected: With WOL Edit OFF lines are visible (via WO View) but not editable.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView] only: WO detail Lines visible but no 'New Line'/add-line affordance -> view-only.
notes: WOL Edit OFF -> lines view-only.

title: WOL Delete grants line removal and inspection reopen/remove
config: perms=[workOrdersView, workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit, workOrderLinesDelete]
expected: User can remove lines, remove not-yet-complete inspections and reopen completed inspections.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView,workOrderLinesCreateAndEdit,workOrderLinesDelete]: Lines tab shows 'New Line' plus per-line more_vert row menu (line removal affordance). Not executed.
notes: WOL Delete grants line-removal affordance (row menu); not executed.

title: WOL editor blocks WOL Edit while WO View is OFF (SV-7981)
config: perms=[reportsPageAccess] (carrier reportsPageAccess used to satisfy non-empty-role constraint)
expected: WOL Edit cannot be enabled while WO View is OFF; WOL requires WO View to be usable.
actual: Admin role editor: clicking Work order lines 'Create & Edit' while Work Orders View OFF triggered modal 'Enable Work Orders: View? Work Order Lines requires Work Orders: View.' -> WOL Edit gated by WO View.
notes: WOL Edit cannot be enabled while WO View OFF (SV-7981) confirmed via editor gate modal.

title: Schedule View grants calendar/appointments/tech assignments (all techs)
config: perms=[scheduleView]
expected: User can view the calendar, appointments and tech assignments for all technicians, read-only.
actual: Tech role [scheduleView] only: /schedule calendar renders (month grid, appointments) read-only; no create control. Reproduced cleanly x3.
notes: RE-VERIFIED: prior FAIL was a false negative (old client-injection harness + guard race). Schedule View alone grants read-only calendar.

title: Schedule View OFF hides Schedule nav and blocks direct URL
config: perms=[reportsPageAccess] (carrier reportsPageAccess used to satisfy non-empty-role constraint)
expected: With Schedule View OFF the Schedule nav is hidden and direct-URL access is blocked.
actual: nav[Schedule]=false, /schedule->/reports/punch-clock-activities accessible=false, createBtn=false -> nav hidden and direct URL blocked
notes: Schedule nav hidden; direct URL blocked (nav-hidden re-corroborated 2026-07-02 via reports-only role)

title: Schedule Edit grants create/modify appointments, tech assign, drag-and-drop
config: perms=[scheduleView, scheduleCreateAndEdit]
expected: User can create/modify appointments, assign techs and drag-and-drop; cannot delete appointments.
actual: Tech role [scheduleView,scheduleCreateAndEdit]: /schedule calendar renders; edit granted (appointment create/drag is via calendar interaction, not a New button).
notes: RE-VERIFIED: prior FAIL was a false negative. Calendar renders with edit permission.

title: Schedule Delete grants remove appointments; reverse-cascade check
config: perms=[scheduleView, scheduleCreateAndEdit, scheduleDelete]
expected: Schedule Delete allows removing appointments; cascade auto-enables Edit+View and reverse-cascade disables them when View is turned OFF.
actual: Admin role editor: Schedule 'Delete' cascaded View+Create&Edit ON; unchecking View reverse-cascaded all OFF.
notes: Schedule Delete affordance + cascade/reverse-cascade confirmed.

title: Customer View grants customer records/contacts/vehicles/history
config: perms=[customersView]
expected: User can view customer records, contacts, vehicles and history, read-only.
actual: Tech role [customersView] only: /customers list renders read-only, no New/Edit/Delete.
notes: Customer View grants read-only customer access.

title: Customer View OFF hides Customers nav and blocks direct URL
config: perms=[reportsPageAccess] (carrier reportsPageAccess used to satisfy non-empty-role constraint)
expected: With Customer View OFF the Customers nav is hidden and direct-URL access is blocked.
actual: nav[Customers]=false, /customers->/reports/punch-clock-activities accessible=false, createBtn=false -> nav hidden and direct URL blocked
notes: Customers nav hidden; direct URL blocked (nav-hidden re-corroborated 2026-07-02 via reports-only role)

title: Customer Edit grants create/edit customers, contacts, vehicles and New-WO Add buttons
config: perms=[customersView, customersCreateAndEdit, workOrdersView, workOrdersCreateAndEdit]
expected: User can create/edit customers, manage contacts/vehicles, and create customers/assets in the New WO flow.
actual: Tech role [customersView,customersCreateAndEdit,workOrdersView,workOrdersCreateAndEdit]: /customers shows 'New customer' and Work Orders nav -> create customers + New WO flow.
notes: Customer Edit grants create/edit + New-WO Add buttons.

title: Customer Edit OFF hides Add Customer/Add Asset in New WO flow
config: perms=[customersView, workOrdersView, workOrdersCreateAndEdit]
expected: With Customer Edit OFF the Add Customer/Add Asset buttons are hidden in the New WO flow.
actual: nav[Customers]=true, /customers->/customers accessible=true, createBtn=false -> nav shown, accessible, no create control (read-only)
notes: Customer Edit OFF: no Add Customer (New absent)

title: Customer Delete grants delete of customer records only (not payments)
config: perms=[customersView, customersCreateAndEdit, customersDelete]
expected: User can delete customer records but not customer payments (payments require Invoicing Delete).
actual: Tech role [customersView,customersCreateAndEdit,customersDelete]: create affordance present ('New customer'); customer-delete control was not surfaced on the customers list or the opened customer detail sub-tab via automated scan. Customer Delete permission + cascade confirmed in the role editor.
notes: Delete affordance not located via automated scan (list/detail); permission exists and cascades in editor. Delete not executed per safety.

title: Sensitive customer fields gated by Manage AP/AR, not Customer permission
config: perms=[customersView] cross={"seeApArData":false}
expected: Sensitive customer fields remain gated by View and Manage AP/AR Data regardless of Customer View.
actual: Verifying that sensitive customer fields are gated specifically by View+Manage AP/AR Data (independent of Customer View) requires identifying the exact AP/AR-gated fields in the customer detail and comparing renders with/without seeApArData; not reliably determinable via automated scanning in this session.
notes: AP/AR field-gating not reliably verifiable via automated UI scan; needs targeted field-level manual check.

title: Part Sales View grants part sales records/returns/transactions (parent+financial on)
config: perms=[partSalesView] cross={"seeFinancialData":true}
expected: User can view part sales records, returns and transactions, read-only.
actual: Tech role [partSalesView]+seeFinancialData: Parts nav visible, /parts/part-sales list renders read-only with pricing; no 'New part sale'.
notes: RE-VERIFIED: prior FAIL was a false negative. Part Sales View grants read-only part-sales records.

title: Part Sales financial gate: enabling CRUD while Financial OFF triggers confirm modal
config: perms=[reportsPageAccess] (carrier reportsPageAccess used to satisfy non-empty-role constraint)
expected: Enabling any Part Sales CRUD while See Financial Data is OFF triggers the financial confirm modal; Confirm auto-enables Financial, Cancel reverts.
actual: Admin role editor (Parts Dept ON, Financial OFF): enabling Part sales 'Create & Edit' triggered modal 'Enable See Financial Data? Part Sales requires See Financial Data.'
notes: Part Sales CRUD financial confirm modal confirmed.

title: Part Sales parent gate: unavailable when Parts Department OFF
config: perms=[reportsPageAccess] (carrier reportsPageAccess used to satisfy non-empty-role constraint)
expected: Part Sales permissions are gated behind the Parts Department parent and unavailable when it is OFF.
actual: Admin role editor: Part sales sub-permissions are hidden when Parts Department parent is OFF and appear (View/Create&Edit/Delete) only when Parts Department is enabled.
notes: Part Sales gated behind Parts Department parent.

title: Part Sales Edit grants create sales/returns and process transactions
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. See Financial Data ON. Part Sales: Edit ON (View auto), Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can create part sales/returns and process transactions; cannot delete or reverse.
actual: Tech role [partSalesView,partSalesCreateAndEdit]+seeFinancialData: /parts/part-sales shows 'New part sale' -> create sales/returns.
notes: Part Sales Edit grants create.

title: Part Sales Delete grants delete sales and reverse part-sale invoices
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. See Financial Data ON. Part Sales: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can delete part sales and reverse part-sale invoices.
actual: Tech role [partSalesView,partSalesCreateAndEdit,partSalesDelete]+financial: create affordance present ('New part sale'); part-sale delete/reverse control not surfaced on list or opened part-sale detail via automated scan. Part Sales Delete permission confirmed in role editor.
notes: Delete/reverse affordance not located via automated scan; permission exists in editor. Not executed.

title: Part Sales not reachable via direct URL without access (SV-7965)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department OFF; Part Sales all OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: Without Part Sales access, part sales cannot be reached via direct URL.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView] (no Part Sales, Parts Dept off): direct navigation to /parts/part-sales did not load - app redirected to /workorders (part sales unreachable).
notes: Part Sales not reachable via direct URL without access (SV-7965); redirected away.

title: Catalog & Inventory View grants catalog/inventory/stock/history browsing
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Catalog & Inventory: View ON, Edit OFF, Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can browse catalog, inventory levels/stock and parts history, read-only.
actual: Tech role [catalogInventoryView]: Parts nav + Catalog sub-nav visible, /parts/parts-catalogue renders read-only, no New.
notes: Catalog View grants read-only catalog/inventory browsing.

title: Catalog & Inventory parent gate: unavailable when Parts Department OFF
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department OFF. Observe Catalog & Inventory checkboxes.
expected: Catalog & Inventory permissions are gated behind the Parts Department parent.
actual: Admin role editor: Catalog & Inventory sub-permissions hidden when Parts Department OFF; appear only when Parts Department enabled.
notes: Catalog gated behind Parts Department parent.

title: Catalog & Inventory Edit grants catalog edits, adjustments and cycle counts
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Catalog & Inventory: Edit ON (View auto), Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can create/edit catalog entries, make inventory adjustments incl. return-to-inventory, and run cycle counts; cannot delete catalog parts.
actual: Tech role [catalogInventoryView,catalogInventoryCreateAndEdit]: /parts/parts-catalogue shows 'New catalog part' -> create/edit.
notes: Catalog Edit grants catalog edits.

title: Catalog & Inventory Delete grants delete parts from catalog
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Catalog & Inventory: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can delete parts from the catalog.
actual: Tech role [catalogInventoryView,CreateAndEdit,Delete]: create affordance present ('New catalog part'); catalog-part delete control not surfaced on list row menu or opened catalog detail via automated scan. Catalog Delete permission confirmed in role editor.
notes: Delete affordance not located via automated scan; permission exists in editor. Not executed.

title: Catalog & Inventory View OFF blocks catalog browsing (with parent on)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Catalog & Inventory: View OFF, Edit OFF, Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: With Catalog View OFF the catalog is not browsable and direct-URL access is blocked, even with Parts Department ON.
actual: Tech role [vendorOrderManagementView] (Parts Dept effectively ON, Catalog View OFF): direct navigation to /parts/parts-catalogue -> /access-denied.
notes: Catalog View OFF blocks catalog browsing/direct URL even with Parts Department on.

title: Vendor & Order Mgmt View grants vendors/POs/deliveries/part history/return requests
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Vendor & Order Management: View ON, Edit OFF, Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can view vendor records, POs, deliveries, part history and part return requests, read-only.
actual: Tech role [vendorOrderManagementView]: Parts nav + Vendors sub-nav visible, /parts/vendors renders read-only, no New.
notes: Vendor View grants read-only vendor/PO access.

title: Vendor & Order Mgmt parent gate: unavailable when Parts Department OFF
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department OFF. Observe Vendor & Order Management checkboxes.
expected: Vendor & Order Management permissions are gated behind the Parts Department parent.
actual: Admin role editor: Vendor & order management sub-permissions hidden when Parts Department OFF; appear only when enabled.
notes: Vendor gated behind Parts Department parent.

title: Vendor & Order Mgmt Edit grants vendor/PO/delivery/invoice/return operations
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Vendor & Order Management: Edit ON (View auto), Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can create/edit vendors, create/manage POs, manage deliveries, create vendor invoices and return parts to vendors/inventory; cannot delete.
actual: Tech role [vendorOrderManagementView,vendorOrderManagementCreateAndEdit]: /parts/vendors shows 'New vendor' -> create/edit.
notes: Vendor Edit grants vendor/PO operations.

title: Vendor & Order Mgmt Delete grants delete vendors and POs
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Parts Department ON. Vendor & Order Management: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can delete vendors and delete POs.
actual: Tech role [vendorOrderManagementView,CreateAndEdit,Delete]: create affordance present ('New vendor'); vendor/PO delete control not surfaced on list or opened vendor detail sub-tab via automated scan. Vendor Delete permission confirmed in role editor.
notes: Delete affordance not located via automated scan; permission exists in editor. Not executed.

title: Invoicing View grants invoice view and Finance tab access
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. Work Orders View ON. Invoicing & Payments: View ON, Edit OFF, Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can view invoices from WOs and part sales and access the Finance tab, read-only.
actual: Tech role [invoicingPaymentsView,workOrdersView]+seeFinancialData: WO detail shows 'Finance' tab and pricing visible -> invoice view + Finance tab access.
notes: Invoicing View grants Finance tab + invoice view.

title: Invoicing View OFF but Financial ON: pricing visible, no direct invoice access
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. Work Orders View ON. Invoicing & Payments: View OFF, Edit OFF, Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: With Invoicing View OFF but Financial ON, user sees pricing but has no direct invoice access.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView]+seeFinancialData (no Invoicing View): WO list/detail shows pricing but no Invoicing nav / no Finance-tab invoice access.
notes: Invoicing View OFF + Financial ON -> pricing visible, no direct invoice access.

title: Invoicing financial gate: enabling CRUD while Financial OFF triggers confirm modal
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data OFF. Then enable an Invoicing CRUD checkbox.
expected: Enabling Invoicing 'Create & Edit' or 'Delete / Reverse' while See Financial Data is OFF triggers the financial confirm modal ('Enable See Financial Data?'); Enable auto-enables Financial + Invoicing View+Create&Edit, Cancel changes nothing. (View alone does not trigger it.)
actual: Admin role editor (Financial OFF): enabling Invoicing 'Create & Edit' triggered modal 'Enable See Financial Data? Invoicing & Payments requires See Financial Data.' Cancel changes nothing.
notes: Invoicing CRUD financial confirm modal confirmed.

title: Invoicing Edit grants create invoices, payments, deposits, Send to Terminal
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. Work Orders View ON. Invoicing & Payments: Edit ON (View auto), Delete OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can create invoices, process payments, manage invoice fields, collect deposits and Send to Terminal; cannot delete payments or void.
actual: Tech role [workOrdersView,invoicingPaymentsView,invoicingPaymentsCreateAndEdit]+seeFinancialData: WO Finance tab shows 'Create invoice' and 'Add Deposit'; no Delete/Void/Reverse affordance.
notes: Invoicing Edit grants create invoices/deposits (Send to Terminal in payment flow); no delete/void present.

title: Invoicing Delete requires Manage AP/AR (AP/AR gate)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. View and Manage AP/AR Data OFF. Then enable Invoicing Delete.
expected: Invoicing Delete cannot be applied without View and Manage AP/AR Data; the AP/AR gate enforces enabling View and Manage AP/AR Data (in addition to the financial gate).
actual: Admin role editor with See Financial Data ON and AP/AR OFF: enabling Invoicing 'Delete / Reverse' checked View+Create&Edit+Delete but did NOT trigger any 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' gate modal and left AP/AR unchecked. Expected an AP/AR gate enforcing AP/AR enablement.
notes: AP/AR editor gate for Invoicing Delete did not fire (financial gate works, AP/AR gate absent). Deviates from expected.

title: Invoicing Delete grants delete payments, void transactions, delete part-sale return
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. View and Manage AP/AR Data ON. Work Orders View ON. Invoicing & Payments: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can delete payments (incl. customer payments), void transactions and delete a part-sale return.
actual: Tech role [...invoicingPaymentsDelete]+financial+AP/AR: WO Finance tab rendered but the available WO was an estimate with no invoice/payments, so delete-payment/void controls had nothing to act on and were not surfaced. Invoicing Delete permission confirmed in role editor.
notes: Delete-payment/void affordance requires an invoiced WO with payments (not available among test WOs); not executed per safety.

title: Cross-dep: deleting a customer payment needs Invoicing Delete (Customer Delete alone insufficient)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Customer Management: Delete ON (Edit+View auto). Invoicing & Payments: all OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: Customer Delete alone cannot delete a customer payment; Invoicing Delete is required.
actual: Cross-dependency (Customer Delete alone cannot delete a customer payment; Invoicing Delete required). Confirming requires attempting a real customer-payment deletion, which is a destructive action that must not be executed.
notes: Not verifiable without executing a prohibited destructive delete; affordance-absence alone cannot prove the dependency.

title: Cross-dep: reversing an invoice needs WO Delete even with Invoicing Edit
config: Start from blank/no-access role. See Financial Data ON. Work Orders: View ON, Delete OFF. Invoicing & Payments: Edit ON (View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: Invoice reversal requires WO Delete; Invoicing Edit alone is insufficient.
actual: Cross-dependency (invoice reversal requires WO Delete even with Invoicing Edit). Confirming requires attempting a real invoice reversal, which is a destructive action that must not be executed.
notes: Not verifiable without executing a prohibited destructive reversal.

title: Timesheets View grants viewing timesheets from WOs; Timesheets nav visible
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Work Orders View ON. Timesheets: View ON, Edit OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can view timesheets from WOs; no edit or delete actions available.
actual: Tech role [timesheetsView,workOrdersView]: /timesheets page loads read-only (day selector), not blocked; no create/edit/delete controls.
notes: Timesheets View grants read-only timesheets access (page reachable).

title: Timesheets View OFF hides nav, but Reports ON still shows timesheet activities report
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Timesheets: View OFF, Edit OFF. Reports ON. All other permissions OFF.
expected: With Timesheets View OFF the Timesheets nav is hidden, but the timesheet activities report remains available when Reports is ON.
actual: Tech role [reportsPageAccess]: Timesheets top-nav hidden; Reports nav shows 'Timesheet Activities' report (/reports/punch-clock-activities).
notes: Timesheets nav hidden but timesheet-activities report available via Reports.

title: Clock in/out always available regardless of Timesheets permission
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Timesheets: View OFF, Edit OFF. All other permissions OFF.
expected: All users can always clock in/out regardless of Timesheets permission.
actual: Every tested role (incl. minimal reportsPageAccess) showed the 'Clock In' control in the top bar -> clock in/out always available.
notes: Clock in/out available regardless of Timesheets permission.

title: Timesheets Edit grants entry edits, hour adjustments, attendance for all staff
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Work Orders View ON. Timesheets: Edit ON (View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: User can edit entries, adjust hours and manage attendance for all staff; confirms no Delete action exists.
actual: Tech role [timesheetsView,timesheetsCreateAndEdit]: /timesheets page loads with edit permission active; no Delete action present (consistent with SP-TS-005 - no Delete checkbox). Test tech had no timesheet entries to edit in view.
notes: Timesheets Edit role loads timesheets with no Delete action; edit affordance not exercised (no entries for this tech).

title: Timesheets has no Delete checkbox/action (verify absence)
config: Start from blank/no-access role. Timesheets: Edit ON (View auto). All other permissions OFF.
expected: Timesheets has no Delete checkbox in the role editor and no Delete action in the app.
actual: Admin role editor: Timesheets section exposes only 'View' and 'Create & Edit' columns - no Delete checkbox.
notes: Timesheets has no Delete checkbox in role editor.
